_comment: Canonical mutate scope for the crypto mutation gate (ADR 0045). The single source of truth for WHAT Stryker mutates, read by both web/stryker.config.mjs (the mutator) and scripts/mutation_meta_check.py (the guard that asserts something was in fact mutated) — two languages, neither able to parse the other's config, so a restated scope would drift the mutator and its guard apart. Paths are web-relative (Stryker's cwd = web/). An EXPLICIT file list, never a directory glob: ADR 0045 §3 curates a logic tier and excludes the wiring layer. Measured, which is why the argon workers are absent — argon.worker.ts 0.00% (21/21 NoCoverage: no test ever instantiates the Worker) and argonWorker.ts 19.67% (worker-vs-fallback PATH survivors: the tests pin the crypto RESULT, byte-identical either way), against v1.ts's 97.76%. Both are execution placement, not crypto; scoring them together reports the misleading number §3 exists to prevent.
